title: Chicken Strike
description: Meet the new exciting third-person shooter - Chicken Strike! Here you will act as a brave chicken who fights with opponents in different conditions. Buy a variety of skins to make your chicken unique. Enjoy jumping like a real chicken. Get ready for intense battles and become a true chicken champion!

title: Pill Soccer
description: Pill Soccer is a 2-player sports game where you control 3D pill-shaped characters to score more goals than your opponent. You can play with the computer as your opponent or with friends.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Seat Jam 3D
description:
Seat Jam 3D is surely an entertaining puzzle game in which you place the passengers in the correct seats. You simply need to click on the passenger and then click on the correct seat. The first few
levels are very simple, but before long, you'll have to think long and hard before you can put all the passengers in the right seats. Solve the bus rush. They can move
up and down, left and right, but not diagonally. Train your brain with engaging puzzles in Seat Jam 3D. Come and join the game!

title: Find the Ghost Cat
description: Your mission is to track down elusive ghost cats! These sneaky felines are masters of camouflage, blending into their surroundings, fading into transparency, or hiding in shadows. Stay sharp and see if you can find them all!

title: Just Ludo
description: Just Ludo is a tabletop dice board game. Roll the dice and let your chess pieces reach the finish line first, so as to defeat the opponent and win rich rewards. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Animal Link
description: Animal Link is a puzzle game, the goal is to remove all the squares by eliminating the same pattern. The rules of the game are simple and require a certain amount of observation and quick reaction ability.

title: Fight for the Tree
description:
The gaming world is facing a serious tree crisis. Evil forces are running wild, and the trees are in great danger.
As a player, your mission is to protect these precious trees. Even when you're offline, your character will keep fighting to safeguard the trees, constantly accumulating experience and resources.
In the game, there's also a group of cute little sapling creatures imprisoned by the evil forces. You need to rescue them one by one through battles, explorations, and so on.

title: Colored Bricks
description: Colored Bricks is a fun and simple endless game. There are colorful bricks and one on the top. You should move that one to the right or left. When it hits the same color brick, it will destroy all bricks of the row. The challenge is to improve your high score in the limited time that you have! Some bricks have extra time if you destroy them.

title: Grid Blast
description:
Grid Blast is a polished block puzzle for mobile browsers. Place colorful gem blocks on an 8×8 board, complete full rows and columns, and chase high scores with combo streaks.

Tap pieces to rotate them, drag blocks from the tray onto the grid, and swap tray slots when you need a better lineup. Clear special star gems for bonus points. Smooth HTML5 canvas visuals, satisfying sound, and a quick “one more round” arcade feel.

title: Pet Merge
description:
Merge adorable pets! 
Combine cute companions to unlock rare and magical species. 
Pass exciting levels in adventure mode or beat your high score in the classic mode.
Let's Play! Meow

title: Candy Crunch: Sugar Escape
description:
Candy Crunch is a puzzle game where players move colorful block shapes to matching exits.

Each level challenges you to slide and reposition tightly packed blocks with different shapes and colors.

New obstacles appear as you progress, keeping gameplay fresh yet easy to understand. Levels are short, intuitive, and designed for quick, casual sessions.

With smooth controls and relaxing puzzles, Candy Crunch is perfect for logic and problem-solving fans.

title: Mermaids Spot The Differences
description: Dive into an enchanting underwater world with "Mermaids: Spot The Differences"! Explore vibrant ocean scenes teeming with mermaids and sea creatures as you sharpen your observation skills to uncover subtle distinctions. Immerse yourself in the magic of the deep blue and embark on an adventure of keen-eyed discovery!

title: Run N Shoot
description: You run and you shoot. That’s all you do, but this deceptively simple game mixes up the action and racks up the adrenalin with surprises round every corner to ensure you never get bored. Trigger finger itchy?

title: Island Expander
description:
Island Expander — relaxing crafting game. Collect resources, discover 30+ recipes, and grow your island step by step!
It is a cozy crafting game where you transform a tiny island into a paradise.
Collect resources, unlock recipes, craft items — from simple tools to complex machines — and watch your island grow with every step.

Start building your dream island today! ?

title: Mind Games for 2-3-4 Player
description: Mind Games is a huge game where you can find 2-3-4 player games while playing. The game consists of 27 games under various categories like skill games, Brain Games, matching games, pop-it games, mancala, ludo, and Tic Tac Toe games. Each of these games is fun and made for kids and it is safe to play. Most of these games can be played 2 player, 3 player or 4 player.

title: Quackventure
description: Join Quack, the brave duck, on an exhilarating journey through a magical forest brimming with wonder and hidden secrets. Explore enchanting landscapes, solve intriguing mysteries, and embark on an adventure filled with thrilling surprises and endless excitement at every corner!

title: Shadow Stickman Fight
description: Shadow Stickman Fight is an awesome and intense 2D ninja survival arcade game. You have to survive the endless waves of enemies with stickman ninjas. Every time you pass a belt exam, you get the examiner’s hat and weapon. You can use souls to trade items or earn gifts. You have to follow the white dots and hit the enemies. You have to time your attack when enemies are in your attack distance. You can also enter the arsenal and choose different equipment, like helmets and weapons.

title: Poptropica
description:
Join millions of players in the adventures of Poptropica!
Complete unbelievable quests, written by Jeff Kinney, author of the Diary of a Wimpy Kid series!
Customize your character and adopt pets! Decorate your clubhouse and hang out with friends! There's so much to do in Poptropica!
And don't forget to collect prizes and compete with your friends - will you be the island champion?

title: Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor!
description:
Decorate and Makeover your home sweet home with Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor!

Introducing Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor, a home decor game designed exclusively for your aesthetic interior design passions. Dive into the world of decor, where clicking, dragging, and dropping chic furniture transforms empty spaces into captivating living areas.

Your dream home is here. Take away the trash, throw away old and dirty things! Let's have a home makeover with Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor!

title: Kings and Queens Match 2
description: Kings and Queens Match 2 is one of the most anticipated Match 3 sequels! This long-awaited second chapter features 2,500+ incredible levels full of magic and adventure. Join Princess Bella on a magical adventure, matching jewels and crowns to uncover hidden treasures. Create powerful boosters like Royal Bombs, hammers, and arrows to clear obstacles and win big. Stunning graphics and an enchanting soundtrack bring the kingdom to life. Get ready for a royal journey full of fun and surprises!

title: GunFu Stickman 2
description:
Armed with a pistol in each hand, take control of the famous Stickman from the "Gun Fu" series and blast through hordes of enemies!

Reflexes and reaction times will be challenged and put to the test as the never-ending onslaught gets faster and faster!

Unlock more deadly guns and outfits, and customize your Stickman to suit your style!

title: Besties Chinese New Year Celebration
description: Besties Chinese New Year Celebration invites you into a joyful world of color, tradition, and friendship as you help best friends prepare for the Lunar New Year. Dress them up in beautiful traditional outfits, elegant modern looks, and festive accessories inspired by Chinese New Year celebrations.

title: From Nerd To School Popular
description: Embark on a transformation journey “From Nerd To School Popular”! Help our protagonist navigate high school life, overcome challenges, and discover their true potential. With your guidance, they’ll undergo a stylish makeover, gain confidence, and rise to the top of the social ladder. Experience the ultimate high school makeover story and watch as our hero transforms from a shy outsider to a beloved school icon!

title: Tank Battle.io
description:
Players can control the tank to perform various exciting missions and defeat the enemy. Players will have to synthesize a variety of weapons for tanks.
There are many tanks in the game that you can choose according to your preference. While completing the task, you must avoid obstacles at any time, and also constantly resist fire from enemy tanks
Each level mode has a different difficulty that you can choose from.

The higher the level, the higher the stable income received.

title: Screw Color Sorting Master
description: Screw Color Sorting Master is a relaxing yet addictive puzzle game! Sort vibrant colored screws onto poles by moving them strategically—same colors must stack together. With simple controls, hundreds of challenging levels, and satisfying visuals, sharpen your brain and become the ultimate sorting master!

title: Two Stunt Supercars
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Cute Folding Paper
description: Cute Folding Paper is an origami online puzzle game. Combines the creative fun of paper crafts with challenging logic puzzle challenges, making it the perfect game for kids and family play .Perfect for children and good for practicing logic, reasoning, and problem-solving skills. Step by step, solve puzzling origami puzzles where the order of folding is the key to clearing the level.What are you waiting for? If you like our games, please share them with your friends to double the fun!

title: Cyberpunk: Corporation
description:
The corporation takes control of the city. You are the only one who can fight back and free the inhabitants.
Enlist the support of local residents by completing their tasks. Activate the robot and break through the defense line.

title: Cuddle Monster Fusion
description: Engage, Merge, and Challenge! Dive into a world of cuddly creatures where you combine identical monsters to evolve them and keep them from overflowing. But here’s the twist: when the same monsters collide, they transform into an entirely new, adorable creature. Can you merge your way to the ultimate fluffy beast?

title: Slippery Drift Racing
description: Slippery Drift Racing is an adrenaline-pumping racing game where precision and speed go hand in hand. Players can choose between Race and Time Attack modes, tackling five unique and challenging maps. With three difficulty levels—Easy, Normal, and Hard—drivers of all skill levels can enjoy sliding through tight corners, mastering drifts, and racing against the clock or opponents. Perfect for fans of high-speed thrills and skillful maneuvers, every race promises excitement and challenge!

title: Crazy Motorcycle
description:
Drive Nubik along exciting tracks. Jump over gaps, go around obstacles and reach the finish line! Lots of different levels, drive a motorcycle, get there without destruction.

You have to drive a motorcycle with a noob and get to the finish line.
Jump over gaps and go around obstacles at high speed.
Exciting levels are waiting for you!

title: Champions FC
description: Champions FC is a fast-paced, bite-size soccer match where you dribble, pass, and time your kicks to break through defenders and score. Play two quick halves, react to turnovers, and keep the ball in bounds. Nail the perfect moment, hear the whistle, and become Champion.

title: Real Car Parking And Stunt
description: Welcome to Real Car Parking And Stunt, a challenging driving simulation game. Here you’ll control a car and put your parking and stunt skills to the test. Choose stunt mode or parking mode, each level challenges you to park your car accurately while performing exciting stunts.

title: Dino Idle Park
description: Dino Idle Park is a relaxing leisure real estate tycoon where you create and develop a dinosaur amusement park. Expand plots, release and display dinosaurs, optimize queues and parks, hire staff, and upgrade investments to increase funds and income. Balance safety, visitor happiness, and research to keep the park thriving even when youre away.

title: Squid Game Memory Card Match
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Squid Game Memory Card Match! Test your memory and focus as you uncover pairs of iconic Squid Game symbols and characters. Can you keep your cool under pressure and match all the cards before time runs out?
Challenge yourself or compete with friends to see who can master the ultimate memory test. With Squid Game Memory Card Match, every flip brings you closer to victory or defeat – can you handle the pressure?

title: Relaxing cubes and campfire
description: A relaxing and peaceful game with delightful campfire sounds! You can easily learn how to play and win - just place blocks to create and remove vertical and horizontal lines. The game is suitable for all ages.

title: School Escape: Obbie Run!
description:
Run Obbie! The teacher will catch up with you and take you straight to the principal! 
You will play as a schoolboy Obbie. After a conflict with the teacher, you need to escape from school. 
The teacher will try to catch up with you at school, you can't let this happen. 
Collect all the keys and escape from school.

title: Mobile Phone Case Diy
description: This is a mobile phone case game that was designed. Have you ever wanted to create a fashion phone case of your own? In the game, you can show your creativity, enjoy the art of customisation and see your phone evolve the way you like. You can choose your favourite colours, draw, mix, and spray paint your phone case.

title: Slinger Block
description: Guide a red square through compact grid-based puzzles filled with sliding blocks and locked paths. Clear the way, collect every yellow key, unlock the yellow door, and reach the exit to win. Simple rules, clever layouts, and satisfying logic challenges make each level a fun brain teaser.

title: Mustang City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate realistic traffic and monitor your fuel while exploring busy streets. Enjoy stunning night city graphics, transforming the city into a neon-lit spectacle. Pedestrians add unpredictability, and hitting them triggers police chases. Customize your car's appearance and performance. All this chaos is accompanied by your cute dog. Whether evading the cops or just cruising, Mustang City Driver offers a thrilling and visually amazing experience.

title: Halloween Stickman
description: On Halloween when the air was thick with mystery and the streets were decorated with carved pumpkins, you were ready to enjoy the spooky night. But Stickman, your sly friend and perennial trickster set you up and you are in trouble. It's time to punish him in every possible way. How? Yes, you have the super ability to rewind time. So take advantage of it and  punish your enemy on Halloween!

title: Baling Bum
description: Jump into Baling Bum, a hilarious arcade adventure packed with silly challenges, funny levels, and nonstop action. Perfect for students looking for cool math games, silly games, or quick school break fun. Play free online, test your reflexes, and laugh with every move. This casual game mixes arcade chaos with funny bum battles, making it a must-play for fans of funny games, free kids games, and online school games. Can you survive the bum escape?

title: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle
description: Choose one of two Brainrots, transform into them, and engage in intense battles with other players. Defeat opponents and unlock new abilities: a Brainrot morph, unique weapons, and powerful abilities. Every battle is a chance to prove yourself! At level 5, you'll unlock a protective shield, and at level 10, you'll unlock slow-motion , which will give you a huge advantage in battle. Earn titles for your victories, from "Noob" to a true "Pro"!

title: Ragdoll Bounce
description: Jump into a fun 2D challenge where you control a ragdoll launched by a bigger ragdoll. Click to bounce on platforms and keep climbing. But be careful—missing a platform means a big fall!

title: American Block Sniper Online
description:
With its informal look reminiscent of Minecraft, American Block Sniper Online is a top-notch first-person action game. In addition to a large variety of adversaries and stages, the game has an extensive arsenal of weaponry.
American Block Sniper Online is a first-person action game in the world of Minecraft where you must defeat all the enemies in each level before time runs out.

title: Human Evolution Run
description: Start with a skeleton, choose your evolution route.

title: Diamondz
description: DiamondZ is a special variant of Match-3. Here, the goal is not to directly manipulate jewels on the board but to insert them on the left or right side to eliminate groups and make diamonds fall into the mine carts. Help the little miner collect as much wealth as possible!

title: Magnet Truck
description: What happens if you take a car with a huge magnet? It could pull metal right out of the ground and rocks! Upgrade and get more and more expensive metals!

title: Mojo Emoji
description: Moji Emoji is a fun and clever word/emoji puzzle game where each level challenges you to guess the hidden word or phrase from a set of expressive emojis. Think fast, connect the clues, and test your emoji decoding skills across hundreds of creative puzzles.

title: Mission Santa: Deliver the Gifts
description:
Santa must deliver gifts to children in time! There are many kids and only one Santa, so everything has to be done on the fly! Fly in a sleigh on Christmas night and throw gifts down chimneys to make children happy. 

The game helps you feel the atmosphere of the approaching holiday and prepare for the most magical time of the year!

title: Farmer Rush: Idle Farm Game
description: The combination of merging crops, upgrading your farm, and the satisfaction of watching your fields bloom makes this game a perfect pick for players who love farming sims or idle games.

title: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
description:
Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem is an exciting motorcycle racing game. 
In this game you will become a motorcycle racer who travels through city streets and highways, avoiding collisions with other vehicles. You will be able to unlock faster and more powerful motorcycles, each with its own unique handling characteristics, as well as improve the characteristics of your motorcycle. One of the key features of the game is a realistic physics engine that makes the gameplay challenging and exciting.

title: Tower Defense Dragon Merge
description: Experience Tower Defense: Dragon Merge, a thrilling clash of strategy and chaos for hours of unique gameplay. Spin for PowerUps in the in-game shop, expanding your arsenal as you level up to combat invaders. In the frenzy of the alien assault, mash the cannon button for more firepower. Reinforce castle walls and fortify defenses through upgrades for a fighting chance against the relentless onslaught. Face the challenge, strengthen your defenses, and enjoy an exciting blend of strategy and chaos!

title: Beauty puzzle
description: A puzzle game in which you need to connect the pieces in a line. To successfully complete the game, it is important to use its mechanics to your advantage

title: Bunnyhop and Surf Maps
description: Game that brings bunnyhop and surf from "Counter Strike" straight to your browser! The game features a variety of parkour maps, many knife skins, unique bunnyhop mechanics, the ability to accelerate with a knife, and the opportunity to compete with other players to see who can reach the finish line first.

title: Coin Stack Up
description:
Coin Stack Up is a colorful and satisfying puzzle game where strategy meets stacking fun!
Connect and stack coins of the same color to create powerful combinations and clear the board.
To make a valid move, you must connect at least 3 coins of the same color. The bigger the stack, the better the results! Each level comes with specific goals shown at the top of the screen - plan your moves carefully to complete them before you run out of moves.

title: Sort Balls - Cones
description: Immerse yourself in a calming logic puzzle where your goal is to sort colored balls into separate tubes. Plan each move carefully so that every tube contains balls of only one color. The straightforward mechanics gradually evolve into more challenging levels that test your focus and strategic thinking.

title: Word Scramble - Family Tales
description: Want a distraction from the annoyances of daily life, or is your brain tired of solving exactly the same problems? Welcome to Word Scramble: Family Tales! Train your gray matter by solving word search puzzles and level up your vocabulary! An exciting family adventure, colorful locations and engaging play make this game hard to tear yourself away from. The story of a long-awaited child finally arriving in a family will come to life literally in front of your eyes.

title: Build and Run
description: Experience the ultimate blend of running and building in our action-packed game! Navigate through exciting levels by constructing missing parts of the level while running at full speed. Master using horizontal builds, slopes, and ramps to keep moving forward and avoid dangerous traps.

title: 2-3-4 Player Games
description: These games can be played with 2, 3, or 4 players. You can play 21 unique games with your friends, each with different scenarios. The objective of each game is to either score or be the first to reach the finish line. Move swiftly and outpace your opponents! It's time to enjoy with friends!

title: Dream Wedding Planner
description: Plan your dream wedding with Dream Wedding Planner Game, a simulation game for kids and girls who love weddings. You can pick four characters and plan six different aspects of their wedding. You can use various tools to complete each step and create your own style. You can skip the current scene by following the pink arrow on top. You can also print the screen after each step and change your plan as you wish. You can make different design plans for each character and give them a sweet wedding.

title: Frog Knight
description: Frog Bubble your mission is to help a spirited frog pop an array of mischievous bubbles! Using your swift reflexes and strategic skills, you’ll throw your lily pad-shaped projectiles at bubbles to clear each level.

title: NoobHood HalloweenCraft
description: Noobhood is actually a folk hero. Of course, that's how he is in our game too. He has one main goal: to dress in a Halloween costume, prepare his horse for Halloween, and collect all the Halloween coins. Gather all the Halloween coins. You must be very careful; surviving in this dark and scary forest is truly difficult. There are pumpkin monsters in this forest, and you must defeat them with your sword. Throw your sword at the monsters to defeat them all.

title: BAT!zo Runner
description: Become the cutest vampuuurrr bat! Fly, dodge, and collect mysterious red potions in BAT!zo - new addictive endless runner!

title: Ultimate Tower Defense
description: Ultimate Tower Defense is an exciting strategy game that perfectly blends tower defense, battle, and fast-paced action into one addictive experience. In the game, you must carefully protect defense towers and deploy powerful heroes to stop endless waves of enemies. Each tower has unique attack abilities. Select your preferred mode to begin the challenge.

title: Circle Run Endless
description: Circle Challenge is an endless game, you need to keep the circle not touch the line. Collect the gifts and using it to buy the circle in the shop.

title: Car Collision Master
description: Rev up for Car Collision Master Jagged canyons frame your blue jeep versus orange-black rivals on a looping desert track. Smoke trails and starry arches amp the chaos—customize your rig, battle friends, and dominate leaderboards in this wheel-warping thrill ride. Feel the V8 roar; claim victory in dust and daring!

title: Doge Rush Draw Home Puzzle
description: Welcome to Doge Rush: Draw Home Puzzle! It's full of lovely adventures. There are two ways to play this game. In the Animal family party, you should help the dog and cat find their food and guide them home, drawing a line between the dog and cat's correct food. And avoid them bumping into each other. If they hit, they will get dizzy and the game will fail.

title: MycoThreeMemo
description: Welcome to the quiet hunt, mushroom picker! Embark on an exciting journey through a virtual forest where mushrooms change shape depending on their habitat and the time of the year! In this puzzle game, you have to be careful and have a good memory to find three mushrooms of the same species. Keep in mind that even mushrooms of the same species can look different! Don't forget that there may be a lot of mushrooms in the forest, but your time is always limited. Think fast, but accurately!

title: Sheep Sort Puzzle Sort Color
description: Sheep Sort Puzzle Sort Color is a fun and addictive puzzle game. You must move the sheep from one enclosure to another in order to match them by color. When all enclosures contain only sheep of the same color, you win. Dozens of challenging levels await your challenge, allowing you to exercise your brain in a fun and colorful environment. Have fun playing!

title: Spacebar Clicker
description: Set out on an epic cosmic adventure in Spacebar Clicker! Click your way through the space, gather light years, and recruit aliens to supercharge your journey. Unlock awesome rewards and aim for that cosmic jump to the next galaxy. Can you collect enough light years to uncover the secrets of the universe?

title: Colossatron
description:
Take charge of a giant robotic snake and smash through cities with ease as you fight to create the most fearsome weapon of all time.
Unleash the power of Colossatron! A unique combination of Match 3 and Snake gameplay allows you to build a devastating machine by merging colored power ups to create new and more powerful weapons. With thousands of potential combinations, the key to victory lies in mastering the art of building Colossatron to take down formidable bosses.

title: Celebrities Get Ready For Christmas
description: Step into the world of ‘Celebrities Get Ready for Christmas’! Join your favorite stars as they prepare for the festive season. Explore dazzling holiday outfits, glamorous decorations, and witness the magic of Christmas through the eyes of celebrities. Get ready for a star-studded holiday celebration! Play and have fun!

title: Shape Transform Race
description: Shape Transform Race is a fun racing game that can be played in reaction-based 1 and 2 player game modes. You can play the game against bots or against your friend. Always be the fastest by choosing the right vehicle for the terrain! You can unlock new vehicles and characters with the coins you earn from the races.

title: Car Jam: Traffic Puzzle
description: Get ready for Car Jam: Traffic Puzzle, the ultimate test of logic and fun! Untangle the traffic, move the cars, and clear the way in this addictive puzzle adventure. With every level, new challenges appear—packed parking lots, tricky buses, and colorful traffic jams waiting for your brainpower. Easy to play, hard to master, and endlessly entertaining.

title: Magic Kingdom. Hex Match
description: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match is a game where you are the third son of a great king, sent to a distant land to prove your worth. Collect six vital resources—food, water, stone, wood, workers, and metal—to construct new buildings. Unlock all structures and create a stunning, magical kingdom!

title: Bubble Shooter Hawaii
description: Bubble Shooter Hawaii is a bubble shooter game with a hawaii theme and classic gameplay combined with special bubble mechanics. It's unique level map will guide you to the challenging levels with unique bubbles like the horizontal row destroyer, the rocks or the hidden bubbles.

title: Cubatoria Merge 2048
description:
Welcome to the exciting world of Cubatoria Merge 2048! This game combines elements of the classic 2048 game with a three-dimensional visual design, which makes it unique and exciting.

The game is designed for fans of puzzles, logic games and those who appreciate a creative approach to classic concepts. Cubatoria Merge 2048 promises an exciting immersion in virtual space with the opportunity to enjoy a new visual experience.

title: Block Puzzle - Frozen Jewel
description: An addictive block puzzle game that helps train your eyes and brain. It is a combination between the Tetris and Jewels game styles.

title: Ragdoll Mega Dunk
description:
Welcome to the Ragdoll Mega Dunk indoor extreme basketball club! The game is a cool Ragdoll style basketball simulator .
Every attempt to do a trick will be unique! Throw the ball into the basket and fly there yourself!

title: Fight to the end
description: Players control a protagonist, an assault soldier, who needs to keep moving and fend off enemy attacks during the battle to survive until the end. Each time the protagonist levels up, the player can choose one of three randomly offered buffs, which are divided into skill - type and bonus - type. Skill - type buffs allow the protagonist to add or enhance skills, while bonus - type buffs are related to the character.

title: Escape Room Mystery Key
description: Escape Room Mystery Key is an intense escape room adventure filled with horror and puzzle elements. Choose a role to enter an abandoned school or a hospital. Uncover hidden clues and keys to find your way out. In this game, you must carefully examine every detail in the room, searching for hidden clues.

title: Donne's Spinning World
description:
In this 2D puzzle-platformer, you can spin the entire world using magical leaves. Rotating the world changes gravity and helps you reach new paths.

The goal is to collect all the flowers in each level.
Along the way, you'll need to push boxes, open doors, and avoid spikes and silly monsters.

Jump, rotate, and solve puzzles in a colorful world full of fun challenges!

title: Enchanted Mahjong Saga
description: Enchanted Mahjong Saga is a fast-paced twist on the classic tile-matching game, with unlimited levels to challenge your mind. Match tiles, beat the clock, and keep your streak alive as each level gets tougher and more exciting. Feeling stuck? Use helpful hints to get back on track and stay in the game.Whether youre playing for a quick break or settling in for a longer session, theres always a new puzzle waiting.

title: Digital Aqua
description:
Digital Aqua is a digital aquarium designed for PC Browser.
Explore the vibrant world of aquariums, where colorful tropical fish and stunning underwater landscapes come to life.
Transform your Monitor into a serene and enchanting aquarium that fills your living room with comfort and wonder.

title: Pop Puzzle
description: Dive into the vibrant world of Pop Puzzle, a colorful block-busting challenge that tests your strategy and quick thinking. Tap on groups of matching blocks to clear the screen and progress through levels filled with satisfying chain reactions. Simple, addictive, and fun for players of all ages.

title: Fashion Stylist Salon Makeover
description: Do you want to create your own fashion styles? Join our best hair salon simulator game and enjoy the utmost fun. You will act as a fashion stylist who does haircuts, hairstyling, and skin care. Welcome customers with different requirements and use your hairstyling skills to make them satisfied and happy!

title: Single Stroke: Energy Line Puzzle
description: Single Stroke: Energy Line Puzzle is a fun and simple way to train your brain every day. This mind-challenging game has easy rules—just connect all the circles using a single continuous line. It’s a great way to keep your brain sharp with quick, clever puzzles. Spend just a few minutes daily to give your mind a boost. Enjoy this brain-training experience anytime, anywhere!

title: Dino Survival: 3D Simulator
description: Survive in this prehistoric Jurassic park. Tame and grow dinosaurs, fight dinos, explore uncharted territories and incredible areas. Build your settlement. Sail to distant islands. Go to Raid! Conquer! Defeat raptors and the huge T-Rex!

title: The Counterfeit Bank
description:
The Counterfeit Bank: Fake Money Tycoon Simulator
Think Plague Inc, but with counterfeit cash! Your goal: dominate the economy one fake note at a time.
Taxes are soaring, inflation’s out of control, and recession looms—perfect chaos for your evil plan. Print counterfeit money, outsmart enforcers, and flood the market with fake cash to disrupt the system.
Can you survive the chaos and take over the economy before time runs out? Mwahahaha!

title: School Teacher Simulator
description:
Evaluate the students' answers in the Teacher Simulator game! Give grades to students, check your homework  and test your school knowledge! This is a cool game for teachers, as well as for students who want to try themselves as a teacher!

In the Teacher Simulator game, you will have to evaluate students' answers, check their homework, conduct tests for two-year students and check your school knowledge. Become the best teacher and cope with any challenges that your students throw at you!

title: Pixel Pop
description: Pixel Pop is a colorful puzzle game where you clear pixel art by matching tanks to pixels. Tanks move along a rectangular loop conveyor and shoot horizontally at matching-color pixels to remove them.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Bank Robbery 3
description: Bank Robbery 3 is a shooting FPS game, the third installment in the Bank Robbery game series. Get ready to pull off the ultimate heist as you prepare to rob the most secure bank in town!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Table Tower Online
description: Table Tower Online is a casual game where you draw your block out with care, balance it accurately, and celebrate victory when your opponent knocks the tower over. You have 54 blocks assembled into a tower.

title: Hide & Seek Go And Find
description: Enjoy the classic game of Hide & Seek in a whole new way with 'Hide & Seek - Family Edition'! Play offline with up to five characters: mother, father, child, police, and thief, each with their unique role. Fathers seek their children, mothers search diligently, children hunt for hidden chocolates, police track down thieves, and thieves sneakily collect treasures.

title: Push.io
description: Push.io is a fast-paced arena game where you battle to stay on the map and push everyone else off. Wield your boomerang with precision to knock rivals into the water while dodging incoming attacks. The longer you survive, the higher you rank; fall early, and you’ll drop in the standings. Earn trophies, upgrade your boomerang between rounds, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate arena champion.

title: Pixel Warfare
description: Pixel Warfare is an IO multiplayer shooting game featuring blocky graphics and 8-bit music, offering a retro experience. The fast-paced, tactical gameplay delivers an exciting FPS experience, with various weapons and maps that keep you on your toes.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Fruit Jam Master
description: Enter the juiciest and most addictive puzzle adventure ever. Enjoy a fun logic puzzle game in Fruit Jam Master. You need to help all the animals leave the grassland to win. Pay attention to the color of the food. Animals can only pass through when the food matches their own color.

title: Monster Girls Back to School
description: Welcome to Monster Girls Back To School. Join the Monster Girls as they prep for school! Assist them in selecting the ideal outfits for a stylish return. Dive into their supernatural world, full of fashion choices and exciting back-to-school adventures. Get ready to be their fashion guide and have fun!

title: Stickman Rocket
description: You have a powerful cannon loaded with Stickman Ragdols which you must shoot far to reach your target! Solve all kinds of challenges as you collect gems, avoid obstacles and control your throws to reach the targets in each level. Try not to bump into obstacles along the way and use all the raggedy characters you need to have fun with these amazing challenges - good luck!

title: Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker
description: Get ready for the cutest twist on the viral Brainrot universe! Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker is the baby-themed sequel to the hit Brainrot Clicker! Tap your way through the baby versions of your favorite characters, collect upgrades, and enjoy a whole new atmosphere with colorful visuals, cheerful music, and fresh sound effects designed to fit the playful baby theme!

title: That's my seat!
description: That's My Seat! is a fun and engaging logic puzzle game where you must place characters in the correct seats by analyzing clues. Each level presents a new seating challenge with unique rules and relationships between the characters. Study the hints, think carefully, and figure out where everyone belongs. Perfect for fans of logic puzzles, brain games, deduction games, and casual puzzle games that test your thinking skills.

title: Melon Drop: Fruit Merge Master
description: Dive deep into the vibrant and enthralling world of fruit-matching with our exciting game, Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game! ??? When the same fruits collide, they merge into a larger fruit. Your mission is to smartly pair the same types of fruits to make the biggest possible fruits without letting them overflow from the container. However, as the fruits grow in size, space becomes a premium - managing it effectively is your key challenge. Can you strategize and solve this fruity puzzle?

title: God For a Day: Prequel
description: God for a Day is a humorous narrative simulation where you take on the divine role of judging the souls of Hopewood City. Examine personal belongings, uncover hidden stories, and decide who to bless or condemn.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game
